title: Registry digests are real and checked: repo refuses a skill entry whose digest is not the sha256 of its source
objective: Make the skill registry's digest field mean what docs/07 says ACTIVE means -- a pin. Every entry's digest equals sha256(source); a placeholder or a stale digest is refused by repo.
business_value: A skill edited without its registry re-pinned is drift the lockfile shows but the registry does not; the placeholder made the field decorative from the start.
in_scope: verify_registry_digests in validate_repo (skill registry; other registries only if they carry digests)
acceptance_criteria: repo passes with every digest real
a skill source edited and re-signed but not re-pinned is refused naming the entry

rollback.method: revert the squash commit via PR

note: Lands IN_PROGRESS by design; reconciled by the next WP's branch.
